findings.text: follow-on: crew gc exposes no way to request pin_unique_commits, so the option added to garbage_collect is reachable only by a direct Python caller and plan section 9's "crew gc can pin" is not yet true from the command line; cli.py is the exclusive write path of a concurrent node, so this is a declared follow-on rather than a scope defect.

follow-on: PROGRAMMING_ERRORS names only TypeError, AttributeError and NameError, so a defect in the sweep that raises KeyError, IndexError or another exception still surfaces as an ordinary GcSweepError refusal instead of a traceback.

item_verdicts.diff: read against 41e6fc48f5b7f9293694519d4c13c4e8c146bb82; the 553f23f6a change is routing.py and the new test, and b083c007 adds the evidence fragment only.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_gc_pins_unique_commits_before_release.py; the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite record that file's run (base 49, head 56, both EXIT=0) and logs/base-arm-abs.log and logs/head-arm-abs.log carry them.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to let gc release a dirty worktree after pinning its unique commits to an archive ref; reckon/crew/routing.py:982 defines _pin_archived_commits and :1463 pins then releases through the residue path, gated on the explicit option at :1301.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command, both arms (base 49 passed EXIT=0, head 56 passed EXIT=0), and the declared mutation with its negative-control log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/routing.py, the new test, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_gc_pins_unique_commits_before_release.py fails under the declared mutation that removes the pin step (logs/negative-control.log, 2 failed of 7), so the release case guards the pin rather than merely passing.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite name tests/test_gc_pins_unique_commits_before_release.py's run and logs/base-arm-abs.log and logs/head-arm-abs.log record 49 and 56 passed with EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: _pin_archived_commits and ARCHIVE_REF_PREFIX sit beside the existing _save_and_release_worktree residue helpers at reckon/crew/routing.py:973 and no symbol carries a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:1463 pins the tree head into refs/reckon/archive/<name> before the removal at :1171, but crew gc at reckon/cli.py:5554 passes no pin option so the capability is reachable only from a direct Python caller.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 41e6fc48..b083c007 touches only reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_gc_pins_unique_commits_before_release.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
